protected_baseline.selection_reason: The direct parent of the recorded reference implementation provides one fixed starting point for both lanes.

task.title: Expose Tenure review and capture task-state contracts
task.brief: Expose stable data-mac-control-id and data-task-state values on review-session, review-workspace, approve, bulk-action, export, and capture popup surfaces while preserving existing product semantics.

existing_behavior: Review approval and rollback semantics remain unchanged.
Bulk export and capture popup rehydration remain unchanged.
The current product has no requirement to expose a public provider or deployment surface for this task.

completion_criteria: Review session, review workspace, approval controls, bulk actions, export, and capture popup expose stable IDs and explicit state values.
Focused QueueShell and popup rehydration tests cover the observable contract.
The implementation preserves existing approval, export, rollback, and capture behavior.
exclusions: No database migration or remote data mutation.
No provider-backed execution, deployment, or external publishing.
No secrets, dependency upgrades, or unrelated UI redesign.
No claim that the recorded reference revision is the current release or a measured AI outcome.

lanes.method: Human-only implementation from the protected baseline.
Bounded AI implementation with human review before acceptance.
lanes.assistant_authority: repository-local edits inside the allowlisted paths; no provider deployment or external mutation

stop_conditions: A lane changes an excluded path or cannot identify a protected baseline.
A required test, receipt, or human review record is missing.
A lane requires a provider, secret, remote database, deployment, or unbounded retry.

behavioral_contract.required_signal: stable control ID plus queue-ready or queue-empty state
stable control IDs plus ready, saving, completed, failed, or selection state
stable workspace/status/control IDs plus state-specific primary target
existing approval, rollback, export, and rehydration semantics remain intact

provenance_checks: Both lane receipts name the protected baseline revision and final revision.
Both lane receipts list changed paths and exact command outcomes.
A human reviewer records the acceptance decision independently of lane self-report.
reconciliation_rules: Missing timing, quality, retry, or recovery data remains unknown.
A passing test is not evidence of a speed gain.
The reference implementation is a contract anchor, not a third lane or a hidden score.

measurement_definitions.active_work_seconds: Wall-clock time spent editing, testing, or reviewing, excluding recorded waits.
measurement_definitions.wait_seconds: Time waiting for commands, tools, or human decisions.
measurement_definitions.human_touches: Distinct human intervention events, including review corrections and acceptance decisions.
measurement_definitions.retries: A repeated command or implementation attempt after a failure or rejection.
measurement_definitions.quality_result: Shared oracle outcome with all required checks and provenance present.

claim_boundary: AL-1 is protocol selection, not a completed paired experiment.
The historical Tenure task and reference revision do not establish AI leverage.
No deployment, provider parity, or current production claim is included.
